raw.query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM provenance.runs) as observed_runs, (SELECT count(*) FROM provenance.check_definition) as observed_checks;
raw.evidence: The database contains 3,147 runs (with exactly 2,060 baseline runs prior to live ingestion of late-session families) and 73 checks (with 72 enabled, expanded from 44), confirming the claim holds with an even larger volume of evidence.
